caption: A Formal Model of Affiliative Interpersonality
author: Stefan Westermann; Sven Banisch

dimensions.caption: Reciprocal friendliness
dimensions.description: Relative frequency or probability of the dyadic relation in which individual A is approach-motivated or friendly and individual B is approach-motivated or friendly. This corresponds to the relation aF bF.

dimensions.caption: A distance and B friendliness
dimensions.description: Relative frequency or probability of the dyadic relation in which individual A is avoidance-motivated or distancing and individual B is approach-motivated or friendly. This corresponds to the relation aD bF.

dimensions.caption: A friendliness and B distance
dimensions.description: Relative frequency or probability of the dyadic relation in which individual A is approach-motivated or friendly and individual B is avoidance-motivated or distancing. This corresponds to the relation aF bD.

dimensions.caption: Reciprocal distance
dimensions.description: Relative frequency or probability of the dyadic relation in which individual A is avoidance-motivated or distancing and individual B is avoidance-motivated or distancing. This corresponds to the relation aD bD.

constraints.description: The four dyadic relation frequencies form a probability vector in the relational state space; therefore, FF + DF + FD + DD must equal 1.
